_meta.notes: Foreign-currency / overseas-asset S-REITs. v2 revision: re-sourced all aggregator URLs (minichart, drwealth, secondary blogs) with primary SGXNet PDFs or issuer IR PDFs. Added property_yield_pct (NPI / portfolio fair value) and gearing_pct_incl_perps where applicable. Note: per primary 1H 2025 statements, Manulife US REIT (BTOU) does NOT have outstanding perpetual securities (the task brief premise of $250M perpetuals was not corroborated by the 1H 2025 condensed financial statements or any other primary disclosure located); gearing_pct_incl_perps therefore set to null with explanatory note. CLCT and CLINT do have perpetual securities (S$149.8m and S$100m respectively) - the FY2025 manager-disclosed aggregate leverage per the Property Funds Appendix already incorporates these securities for CLCT under the deposited-property formula, so a separate 'incl perps' figure is computed for comparison. Manulife US REIT FY2025 results (announced 18 March 2026) are referenced via the IR financial-results landing page and the most recent SGXNet-hosted primary documents (1H 2025 unaudited results, 11 Dec 2025 MRA announcement, Dec 2025 Circular) because the FY2025 SGX PDF could not be located by URL search; aggregator-source numbers were retained only where corroborated across at least two independent primary disclosures.

For 31 Mar 2026, comparable figure would be ~42.0% (manager-disclosed 41.4% headline plus perpetual uplift).

CY6U.name: CapitaLand India Trust (CLINT)
CY6U._notes: CY6U is a BUSINESS TRUST listed on SGX, not a REIT. CLINT is structured as a registered business trust under the Singapore Business Trusts Act (Cap. 31A), with CapitaLand India Trust Management Pte. Ltd. as Trustee-Manager. While colloquially referred to as a REIT and treated similarly for screening purposes, it is governed under business-trust rules rather than the Code on Collective Investment Schemes / Property Funds Appendix. This affects: (i) MAS aggregate-leverage and ICR rules do not directly apply (the manager elects to comply on a voluntary basis), (ii) the trust can undertake direct property development without the 10% development limit applicable to REITs, and (iii) tax transparency at the trust level may differ. Composite screening thresholds should be applied with this distinction in mind.
CY6U.gearing_note: Gearing Ratio 35.7% as at 31 Mar 2026 (down from 39.6% at 31 Dec 2025). Includes CLINT's proportionate share of joint ventures' borrowings. Net Gearing 33.8%. As a business trust, CLINT applies the Property Funds Appendix formula on a voluntary basis.
CY6U.icr_note: Interest Coverage Ratio 2.8x at 31 Mar 2026 (2.7x at 31 Dec 2025). Based on trailing 12 months EBITDA divided by interest expense, borrowing-related fees and distributions on perpetual securities.
CY6U.wace_note: Average Cost of Debt 5.7% (vs 5.6% at 31 Dec 2025). Slightly up due to higher INR debt ratio.
CY6U.pct_fixed_debt_note: % Borrowings on Fixed Interest Rate 78.5% as at 31 Mar 2026 (up from 72.6% at 31 Dec 2025).
CY6U.dpu_ttm_note: FY2025 DPU 7.87 Singapore cents (+15% YoY), comprising 2H 2025 DPU of 3.90 SG cents (+22% YoY). Implied FY2025 distribution yield 6.5% based on closing price S$1.22 as at 31 Dec 2025. 1Q 2026 advance distribution of 1.44 SG cents declared for period 1 January to 4 March 2026 (paid on 10 April 2026, advance distribution due to private placement).
CY6U.dpu_last_period_note: Advance distribution of 1.44 SG cents/unit for 1 January to 4 March 2026 paid on 10 April 2026 (advance distribution due to S$150m private placement launched 24 Feb 2026). This is a partial-quarter advance distribution, not a full 1Q 2026 DPU.
CY6U.dpu_currency_note: Distributions in SGD although underlying assets are INR-denominated. Monthly forward contracts to lock in income to be repatriated.
CY6U.nav_per_unit_note: NAV per Unit S$1.38 (Stable YoY) / INR 97.38 (+12% YoY in INR terms) as at 31 Dec 2025 per FY2025 results released 2 Feb 2026. NAV not separately disclosed in 1Q 2026 business update.
CY6U.occupancy_note: Committed Occupancy 91% as at 31 March 2026 (excludes Logistics Park and Data Centres). 304 total tenants.
CY6U.wale_basis: Weighted Average Lease Expiry 3.3 years; Weighted Average Lease Term 6.6 years. Excludes Logistics Park and Data Centres.
CY6U.num_properties_note: Portfolio comprises completed IT parks (Bangalore ITPB, Chennai ITPC, Hyderabad ITPH, Pune ITPP-H, Mumbai), industrial facilities, 7 warehouses (Logistics Park, Chennai), and 1 data centre (DC Navi Mumbai T1). Total completed buildings: 13 (Bangalore) + 6 (Chennai - 3 IT + 3 industrial) + 9 (Hyderabad) + 8 (Pune) + 10 (Mumbai - 2 IT + 7 warehouses + 1 DC) = 46 buildings across 5 cities. Asset/property count not stated as single figure.
CY6U.aum_note: Portfolio valuation S$3.8bn / INR 266.4bn as at 31 Dec 2025 (+19% YoY on a like-for-like basis, excluding divestments of CyberVale and CyberPearl). Valuations by Cushman & Wakefield (India) Pvt. Ltd. as at 31 Dec 2025 at exchange rate S$1 : INR 70.4. Completed floor area: 21.7 million sq ft existing portfolio (includes CapitaLand Data Centre Navi Mumbai T1). Bangalore 6.0m + Chennai 2.8m + Hyderabad 4.6m + Pune 5.3m + Mumbai 3.2m sq ft.
CY6U.top10_tenant_basis: by Portfolio Base Rent. Largest: Tata Consultancy Services 11%, Applied Materials 7%, Infosys 5%, UnitedHealth Group 3%, Amazon 3%, Synechron 3%, Pegatron 3%, Bristol Myers Squibb 2%, Société Générale 2%, Deloitte 2%.
CY6U.forward_dpu_guidance: Distribution Policy: 90% of income available for distribution to be distributed; 10% retained. Committed pipeline expected to grow floor area 49% to 32.3 million sq ft by 2030 (existing 21.7m + 7.3m forward purchases + 1.9m IT building developments + 1.4m DC developments). Target onshore INR debt 40-50% over next few years. No quantitative DPU guidance.
CY6U.property_yield_note: Computed: FY2025 NPI of S$224.9M / Portfolio valuation S$3,800M as at 31 Dec 2025 = 5.92%. Manager does not disclose a single portfolio cap rate metric. Independent valuation by Cushman & Wakefield (India) Pvt. Ltd. at exchange rate S$1 : INR 70.4 as at 31 Dec 2025.
CY6U.perpetual_securities_note: CLINT issued S$100M of perpetual securities in FY2025 (per FY2025 results presentation: 'Issued S$100 M perpetual securities' under Optimise Capital Structure). The 35.7% manager-disclosed gearing as at 31 Mar 2026 / 39.6% as at 31 Dec 2025 treats perpetuals as equity. Computed gearing including perpetuals as debt: 35.7% headline + ~2.7 ppt uplift for S$100M perpetuals on ~S$3.7bn deposited property ≈ 38.4% as at 31 Mar 2026. Equivalent 31 Dec 2025 figure: ~42.3%. ICR formula already includes distributions on perpetual securities in the denominator (per manager disclosure).
